biotools.summary: GRAPEVINE is a desktop application providing a graphical environment for designing and building analytical workflows, built on the Snakemake workflow management system. It streamlines the creation and sharing of pipelines for infectious disease data analysis, enabling researchers to automate complex workflows and enhance reproducibility.
